articles.summary: In the most recent brigade, 7 out of 10 people who attended were women, 65.1% live in rural areas of the municipality, 29% were under 18 years old, 4% belong to indigenous communities and 0.5% to the Afro-descendant population.
articles.title: GeoPark, Colombian Civil Air Patrol complete 21 medical brigades after third visit to Puerto Lopez

articles.summary: GeoPark has donated more than 2,700 musical instruments and traditional costumes to seven schools in Puerto Gaitan, benefiting over 5,400 students, teachers, and other members of the educational community, including the Sikuani ethnic population.
articles.title: GeoPark donates more than 2,700 musical instruments and traditional costumes to seven schools in Puerto Gaitan
